format: Makefile / Shell script / Build configuration language
description: This file contains Makefile definitions and device-specific build configurations for TP-Link devices within an OpenWRT build system. It defines build rules, device parameters, and image creation procedures for various TP-Link router models.

methods.name: Build/tplink-v1-okli-image
methods.description: Build rule for creating an OKLI image for TP-Link v1 devices, copies kernel, concatenates root filesystem, and runs 'mktplinkfw'.

methods.name: Build/uImage-tplink-c9
methods.description: Build rule for creating uImage format for TP-Link C9 device, uses mkimage to produce a Linux image.

methods.name: Device/tplink-v1
methods.description: Device configuration for TP-Link v1 hardware, defining device identifiers, firmware images, and related parameters.

methods.name: Device/tplink-v1-okli
methods.description: Extended device configuration for TP-Link v1 with OKLI bootloader support, including loader type, addresses, and image parameters.

methods.name: Device/tplink-v2
methods.description: Device configuration for TP-Link v2 hardware, including identifiers and image build procedures.

methods.name: Device/tplink-safeloader
methods.description: Device configuration using a safe loader setup, with specific device IDs and image build routines.
